prompt_md: Five friends sit around a round table. Two seatings count as the same if everyone has the same person on their left. How many different seatings are there?
prompt_short: Five people around a round table. Different seatings?
hint_md: Seat one person first. Only where the others sit relative to them matters.
explain_intuition_md: 120 counts the ways to fill five numbered chairs. But shifting everyone one seat around changes nobody's neighbors, so each real seating shows up 5 times. Fix one person and arrange the other 4.
